name: Robertson's Creek Shopping Center
summary: Robertson's Creek Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination in Flower Mound, Texas, featuring convenient dining and services for local residents. With strong community ratings and accessible hours, it serves as a reliable shopping hub in the northwest Dallas-Fort Worth suburbs.
demographics: Robertson's Creek Shopping Center serves the affluent Flower Mound community in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes above the regional average. The trade area draws from established residential neighborhoods with a demographic profile skewing toward families with children, professionals aged 30-55, and dual-income households. Shoppers in this area typically seek convenient neighborhood retail for dining and everyday services, with a preference for quality casual dining options and accessible strip center formats that allow for quick visits.
description: Robertson's Creek Shopping Center is a neighborhood shopping destination located at 5801 Long Prairie Road in Flower Mound, Texas, serving the growing northwest Dallas-Fort Worth suburban community. This open-air retail center provides convenient access to dining and services for local residents, with Red Robin Gourmet Burgers being one of its notable tenants offering casual family dining. The center operates with extended hours Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and Sunday from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM, accommodating the busy schedules of Flower Mound families and professionals. Managed by Dunhill Partners, Robertson's Creek has established itself as a reliable neighborhood retail hub with a strong 4.4-star rating from over 544 reviews, reflecting its consistent service to the community. The center's strategic location along Long Prairie Road provides easy accessibility for residents throughout Flower Mound and surrounding areas, making it a go-to destination for everyday shopping and dining needs.
